userStories.title: Remove Legacy Sidebar and Implement 4-Icon Left Nav
userStories.description: Replace the current 10+ icon sidebar with a minimal 4-icon persistent left nav: New Spec (+), Hub, Forge, Settings. All other panels are accessed contextually.
acceptanceCriteria: Old Sidebar.tsx is replaced by a new MinimalNav component with exactly 4 icons
Icons are: + (New Spec), grid (Hub), hammer (Forge), gear (Settings)
Active icon is highlighted with accent color
Nav is 48px wide, always visible, no labels
Clicking + opens Forge with empty brief
All old panel-specific nav items are removed

userStories.title: Persistent Top Bar with Wordmark, Workspace Switcher, Run Pill, Network Banner, and Theme Toggle
userStories.description: A full-width top bar contains the Rorca wordmark, a workspace switcher dropdown, and a run pill on the right. Additionally, fold in the existing NetworkBanner.tsx (offline detection) so it renders inline in the top bar rather than as a floating overlay, and wire ThemeToggle.tsx into the top bar right side next to the run pill.
acceptanceCriteria: Top bar is 48px tall, full width, always rendered above content
Wordmark 'rorca' in brand font on far left
Workspace switcher dropdown shows current workspace label, click to switch
Run pill shows '● N/M' when run is active, pulsing blue dot
Run pill shows '+ New Spec' when no run is active
Top bar persists across all screens
NetworkBanner.tsx offline detection is wired into the top bar: amber indicator appears inline when /api/health fails, auto-dismisses on reconnect
ThemeToggle.tsx is rendered in the top bar right side (between run pill and any future icons), toggling dark/light theme

userStories.title: Run Pill Live Updates and Click-to-Jump
userStories.description: The run pill in the top bar updates in real time via SSE and clicking it navigates to Run View.
acceptanceCriteria: Run pill subscribes to /api/pipeline/stream SSE for live story count
Story count updates without page reload
Pulsing animation on the dot when status=running
Click navigates to Run View for the active run
Shows 'done ✓' with green dot when run completes
Pill disappears after 30s post-completion

userStories.title: Hub Screen Layout Scaffold
userStories.description: The Hub screen is the default landing screen after login. It is divided into three vertical sections: Active Run (top), Pending Reviews (middle), Recent Runs (bottom).
acceptanceCriteria: Hub is the default screen on app load when a workspace is configured
Three sections render in order: Active Run, Pending Reviews, Recent Runs
Each section has a bold section header label
Section is hidden if no data exists for it (not shown as empty card)
Screen is scrollable if content overflows
Hub is reachable from the grid icon in the left nav

userStories.title: Hub Active Run Card
userStories.description: When a pipeline run is active, the Hub shows a prominent card at the top displaying real-time run progress.
acceptanceCriteria: Card shows spec name, run ID, current story title, and N/M progress
Progress bar fills proportionally to stories passed / total
Story status updates live via SSE (/api/pipeline/stream)
Card has blue left border when running, green when complete, red when failed
Click card navigates to Run View for that run
Pause and Kill buttons visible on card (functional via existing API)

userStories.title: Hub Pending Review Cards Grid
userStories.description: Pending specs waiting for approval are shown as a grid of cards in the Hub.
acceptanceCriteria: Cards rendered in a 2-column grid (1-column on narrow viewports)
Each card: spec title, story count, generated timestamp, first 2 story titles as preview
Clicking a card opens Spec Review screen for that spec
'Approve' and 'Reject' quick actions on each card
Cards fetched from GET /api/specs?status=pending
Badge shows count of pending reviews in section header

userStories.title: Hub Recent Runs List
userStories.description: A chronological list of past pipeline runs shown in the Hub.
acceptanceCriteria: List shows last 10 runs: spec name, run ID, status badge, started timestamp, duration
Status badges: Running (blue), Passed (green), Failed (red), Cancelled (grey)
Click run row navigates to Run View for that run
Data fetched from GET /api/pipeline/runs
'View all' link navigates to full archive
List updates in real time when a run completes (SSE-driven)

userStories.title: Hub Empty States (No Workspace / No Runs)
userStories.description: Hub shows appropriate empty states depending on whether a workspace is configured and whether any runs exist. Combines both empty state variants into one story.
acceptanceCriteria: When no workspace is registered: full-height centered card with Rorca logo, heading 'Connect your first repository', subtext explaining Rorca in one sentence, single CTA 'Add Workspace' opening workspace registration flow

When workspace is registered but no specs or runs exist: 'Ready to build' heading with brief description, two CTAs: 'Write a brief' (navigates to Forge) and 'Set direction' (navigates to Settings), icon indicating idle/ready state
No section headers rendered in either empty state
Empty state disappears as soon as data exists — no transition delay
Both empty states are responsive and centered at all viewport widths

userStories.title: Run View Full-Screen Layout
userStories.description: The Run View is a dedicated full-screen layout accessible from the Hub active run card or run history. It fills the full content area (no Hub sections visible).
acceptanceCriteria: Run View replaces Hub content area when navigated to
Header bar shows spec name, run ID, status badge, and back button
Tab bar below header: Terminal, Stories, Graph, Compare, Worktrees, Commits
Default tab on open is Terminal
Back button returns to Hub
Run View is accessible via direct URL with run ID

userStories.title: Run View Resizable Split Pane
userStories.description: The Terminal tab of Run View uses a horizontal split pane: terminal on the left, story list on the right. The divider is draggable.
acceptanceCriteria: Split pane divides horizontal space: terminal (default 60%), story list (default 40%)
Draggable divider between panes
Minimum pane width: 200px on each side
Split ratio persisted in localStorage per session
Panes fill full height below the tab bar
Divider has a visible grab handle

userStories.title: Run View Terminal Pane
userStories.description: The left pane of the Terminal tab renders the live xterm.js terminal streaming stdout from the pipeline run.
acceptanceCriteria: @xterm/xterm (NOT the old xterm package) renders in the left pane
@xterm/addon-fit used for resize-aware fitting
SSE stream from /api/pipeline/runs/:runId/output feeds base64-decoded bytes to terminal
Late-join replays full buffer from run start
Terminal auto-scrolls to bottom on new output
Copy button copies full terminal text to clipboard

userStories.title: Run View Story List Pane
userStories.description: The right pane of the Terminal tab shows a scrollable list of all stories in the spec with live status indicators.
acceptanceCriteria: Stories listed in order with ID badge and title
Status icons: grey circle (pending), blue spinner (running), green check (passed), red X (failed), strikethrough (excluded)
Currently running story highlighted with blue left border
Story status updated in real time via SSE (story_started, story_passed, story_failed events)
Click story row scrolls terminal to that story's output start
Passed/failed count summary at bottom of list

userStories.title: Run View Tabs — Compare, Worktrees, and Commits
userStories.description: Add Compare, Worktrees, and Commits tabs to Run View by wiring existing CompareRunsPanel.tsx and WorktreesPanel.tsx into the tab bar. Commits tab shows git log for the active run's branch.
acceptanceCriteria: Tab bar includes: Terminal, Stories, Graph, Compare, Worktrees, Commits
Compare tab renders existing CompareRunsPanel.tsx scoped to the current run's spec (side-by-side current vs previous run, status diff table, summary line)
Worktrees tab renders existing WorktreesPanel.tsx filtered to the current run's worktree (branch name, base branch, merge button, path display)
Commits tab shows chronological git log for the run's branch: short SHA, commit message (truncated 72 chars), timestamp, story ID badge extracted from commit message
Commits tab has 'No commits yet' empty state for in-progress runs and a refresh button
Tab selection persists in URL hash so deep-linking works

userStories.title: Run View Pause, Resume, and Kill Controls
userStories.description: Inline pipeline controls in the Run View header allow pausing, resuming, and killing the active run.
acceptanceCriteria: Pause button calls POST /api/pipeline/runs/:id/pause, changes to Resume when paused
Resume button calls POST /api/pipeline/runs/:id/resume
Kill button calls POST /api/pipeline/runs/:id/kill with confirmation dialog
Controls disabled when run is not active (completed/failed/cancelled)
Button states update in real time via SSE
Kill confirmation: 'Kill this run? This cannot be undone.' with Cancel / Kill buttons

userStories.title: Run View HITL Blocked State
userStories.description: When the run-loop emits a run_blocked WAL event (human-in-the-loop pause), the Run View shows an amber banner with a context injection textarea.
acceptanceCriteria: Amber banner renders below tab bar: 'Run paused — agent is waiting for input'
Textarea below banner accepts free-text context injection
Send button POSTs context to /api/pipeline/runs/:id/context and resumes run
Banner disappears on resume (SSE-driven)
Textarea placeholder: 'Type instructions or context for the agent...'
Send is disabled when textarea is empty

userStories.title: Run View Graph Tab
userStories.description: Wire the existing InteractiveDependencyGraph.tsx component into the Run View Graph tab. Connect SSE story status updates to update node colors in real time (pending/running/passed/failed). The component already has zoom/pan, dagre layout, and node popovers — just wire data and live updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Graph tab renders InteractiveDependencyGraph.tsx with the current spec's userStories array as input
Edges drawn from dependsOn relationships in the spec JSON
Node colors driven by live story status: grey (pending), blue-pulse (running), green (passed), red (failed), strikethrough text (excluded)
Graph subscribes to /api/pipeline/stream SSE — story_started, story_passed, story_failed events update node color in real time without full re-render
SSE subscription reuses the same connection established by the run pill (UI-003) — no duplicate connection
Existing zoom/pan/fit controls and node popovers in InteractiveDependencyGraph.tsx remain functional

userStories.title: Forge Screen Brief Input with Token Count
userStories.description: The Forge screen's brief textarea shows a live estimated token count to help users write appropriately sized briefs.
acceptanceCriteria: Textarea minimum 6 rows, auto-expands to 16 rows max
Live token count estimate shown below textarea (using simple word-count heuristic × 1.3)
Warning at 2000 tokens: 'Brief is long — consider breaking into smaller specs'
Placeholder text: 'Describe what you want to build...'
Character count also shown (X chars)
Brief persists in localStorage between sessions (restored on mount)

userStories.title: Forge Screen Direction Stack Context Sidebar
userStories.description: A sidebar shows a synthesized preview of the direction stack context that will be sent to the LLM.
acceptanceCriteria: Sidebar renders to the right of the brief input (30% width)
Shows L1, L2, L3 layer summaries as collapsed accordions
Each layer shows first 150 chars with 'View full' expand
'No direction configured' placeholder with link to Settings when layers empty
Refresh button re-fetches direction layers
Context updates when workspace is switched

userStories.title: Forge Screen Model Picker and Story Count
userStories.description: Dropdowns for selecting the LLM model and target story count.
acceptanceCriteria: Model dropdown lists all SUPPORTED_MODELS from /api/direction/models
Default shows workspace preferred model or global DEFAULT_MODEL
Story count options: 3, 5, 8, 10, 15, 20, Custom (number input)
Default story count is 8
Selections persist in localStorage
Both dropdowns are accessible via keyboard

userStories.title: Forge Screen Generation Progress Indicator
userStories.description: A 4-stage progress indicator shown during spec generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Stages: Analyzing Brief → Building Context → Generating Stories → Validating Output
Each stage has an icon, label, and elapsed time
Current stage pulses, completed stages show checkmark
Progress replaces the Generate button area during generation
Error state shown inline if generation fails with suggested fix
Cancel button aborts generation (AbortController)

userStories.title: Forge Screen Inline Spec Preview Post-Generate
userStories.description: After generation, the spec is previewed inline without navigating away.
acceptanceCriteria: Story cards appear below the brief area after generation completes
Each card: story ID, title, description excerpt, acceptance criteria count
Expand card to read full acceptance criteria
Story count summary: 'Generated 8 stories'
'Approve & Queue' button at bottom — moves spec to approved/ and shows success toast
'Regenerate' button re-runs generation with same brief
'Edit Brief' returns to brief input with current brief restored

userStories.title: Forge Screen Approve and Run Inline
userStories.description: After approving a spec in Forge, user can immediately trigger a run without leaving the screen.
acceptanceCriteria: After approval, button changes to 'Trigger Run ▶'
Trigger Run opens a modal: workspace selector, autoWorktree toggle, confirm
On confirm: POST /api/pipeline/trigger, success toast, navigate to Run View
'View in Queue' alternative link for users who prefer the queue flow
Approval event written to WAL (spec_approved)

userStories.title: Spec Review Story Cards
userStories.description: A dedicated spec review screen with expandable story cards, accessible from pending review cards in Hub.
acceptanceCriteria: Full-screen layout with spec title header
Story cards in vertical list with ID badge, title, complexity badge
Expand card: shows description, all acceptance criteria as checklist
Collapse returns to single-line view
Keyboard: arrow keys navigate between stories, Enter expands/collapses
Story count and readiness percentage in header

userStories.title: Spec Review Per-Story Exclude Toggle
userStories.description: Individual stories can be excluded before approval.
acceptanceCriteria: Each story card has an 'Exclude' toggle (default off)
Excluded stories show strikethrough title and reduced opacity
excluded: true written to spec JSON on toggle
Excluded count shown in header: '3 stories excluded'
Restore toggle re-includes excluded story
Excluded stories preserved through approve — run-loop skips them

userStories.title: Spec Review Approve and Reject with Keyboard Shortcuts
userStories.description: Keyboard-first approval and rejection flow.
acceptanceCriteria: ⌘↩ (Cmd+Enter) approves spec — confirmation dialog
⌘⌫ (Cmd+Backspace) rejects spec — confirmation dialog with reason input
Approve moves spec to approved/ directory via API
Reject deletes spec and records WAL event spec_rejected
Post-approve: navigate to Forge or trigger run prompt
Reason for rejection stored in WAL payload

userStories.title: Command Palette Extended — Forge Fallback, Context-Aware Scoping, and Recent History
userStories.description: Extend the existing CommandPalette.tsx: add forge fallback (unrecognized input opens Forge with pre-filled brief), add context-aware scoping so palette shows relevant actions based on current screen, and add recent commands history. The component already supports fuzzy search, panel navigation, and spec/run loading.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing CommandPalette.tsx is extended in-place — no rewrite or new component
⌘K opens palette from any screen, Escape closes, backdrop blur overlay present

Forge fallback: when input is non-empty and no command scores above match threshold, top result is '→ Send to Forge as brief' with input echoed in muted text; Enter closes palette, navigates to Forge, pre-fills brief textarea, and focuses it
Forge fallback does NOT appear on single-word input and does NOT appear when a deterministic command matches well
Context-aware scoping: on Run View show run commands first (pause, kill, compare), on Forge show template/recent brief commands first, on Hub show pending review actions first
Recent commands: last 5 used commands stored in localStorage and surfaced at top when input is empty; 'Clear history' option at bottom
All existing navigation and action commands remain functional

userStories.title: Settings Screen Direction Stack Tab
userStories.description: Settings page with Direction Stack as the default tab, replacing the current standalone DirectionStackPanel.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings accessible from gear icon in left nav
Tab bar: Direction Stack (default), Model & Providers, GitHub, Shortcuts, Account
Direction Stack tab shows L1, L2, L3 as separate editor sections
Each layer: textarea editor with Save button
Cascade explanation at top: 'Lower layers override higher ones'
Dirty state tracking: unsaved changes show 'Unsaved' badge on tab

userStories.title: Settings Screen Model and Providers Tab
userStories.description: Configure default LLM model and provider settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Default model dropdown (global, applies when workspace has no preferred model)
Per-workspace preferred model override
Model descriptions: context window, speed indicator, cost tier
'Test model' button sends a minimal test prompt and shows response time
Provider config section (Anthropic API key field, masked input) for SDK path
Save persists to direction_layers workspace L3 preferred_model column

userStories.title: Settings Screen GitHub Tab
userStories.description: GitHub OAuth connection status and repository configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: Connected account shown: avatar, username, connected date
'Disconnect' button revokes OAuth
Per-workspace: linked GitHub repo selector
'Test connection' verifies token is still valid
Auto-PR setting: enable/disable, target branch, reviewer list
Shows scope list of what Rorca can access via GitHub

userStories.title: Settings Screen Keyboard Shortcuts and Account Tabs
userStories.description: Wire existing KeyboardShortcutsPanel.tsx into a Shortcuts tab. Wire existing Account/Billing info into an Account tab. Combines shortcuts overlay, global keyboard shortcut registration, and account management into one story.
acceptanceCriteria: Shortcuts tab renders existing KeyboardShortcutsPanel.tsx content: shortcuts grouped by category (Navigation, Specs, Pipeline, General), each row shows action description + key combination badge
? key opens Settings to the Shortcuts tab from any screen (except when input is focused)
Global keyboard shortcuts registered in app root: ⌘K palette, ⌘N new spec, ⌘↩ approve (review context), ⌘⌫ reject (review context), Ⅸ1-4 for Hub/Forge/RunView/Settings
Account tab: display name edit, email display, password change form (requires current password), 'Delete account' link with confirmation
Account tab changes save via PATCH /api/auth/me
Tab labels in Settings: Direction Stack, Model & Providers, GitHub, Shortcuts, Account
